description.en: Underfitting and overfitting read from learning curves, the bias-variance decomposition derived line by line, and how evaluation itself has bias and variance.
description.zh: 从学习曲线读出欠拟合与过拟合，一行一行推导偏差-方差分解，以及评估本身也有偏差和方差。

name.zh: 欠拟合、过拟合与模型复杂度

name.en: Remedies for high bias and high variance
name.zh: 高偏差与高方差的对策

description.en: Believing more training data fixes high bias
description.zh: 以为多加数据能解决高偏差

description.en: Believing a more complex model always generalises better
description.zh: 以为越复杂的模型泛化越好

description.en: Confusing model bias with evaluation bias
description.zh: 混淆模型偏差与评估偏差

description.en: Expecting test error to reach zero with enough data (the noise floor)
description.zh: 以为数据够多测试误差能到零（忽略噪声下限）

text.en: **Generalisation** is performing well on unseen data. There are two ways to fail at it:
text.zh: **泛化**（generalisation）是在没见过的数据上表现好。有两种失败方式：

items.en: **Underfitting**: the model is not expressive enough to capture the pattern.
items.zh: **欠拟合**（underfitting）：模型表达力不够，抓不住规律。

items.en: **Overfitting**: the model is too complicated; it captures the **noise** of this training set as if it were pattern.
items.zh: **过拟合**（overfitting）：模型太复杂，把这份训练集的**噪声**当成了规律。

items.en: An appropriate fit captures the essential pattern and nothing more.
items.zh: 合适的拟合只抓住本质的规律，不多不少。

alt.en: Fifteen noisy points from a sine curve with polynomial fits of order 1, 3 and 9.
alt.zh: 正弦曲线上 15 个带噪声的点，以及 1 阶、3 阶、9 阶多项式拟合。

text.en: **Model complexity** is the number of adjustable parameters: the order $D$ of the polynomial $y = \mathbf{w}^\top\phi(x)$ with $\phi(x) = [1, x, x^2, \dots, x^D]$, the depth of a decision tree, the number of leaves. $D = 1$ is a line: too stiff (underfit). $D = 9$ passes close to every point and swings wildly between them: it learned the noise (overfit).
text.zh: **模型复杂度**（model complexity）是可调参数的数量：多项式 $y = \mathbf{w}^\top\phi(x)$ 的阶数 $D$（$\phi(x) = [1, x, x^2, \dots, x^D]$）、决策树的深度、叶子数。$D = 1$ 是直线：太僵硬（欠拟合）。$D = 9$ 几乎穿过每个点，点间却剧烈摆动：它学了噪声（过拟合）。

chapter.en: Fitting too little, fitting too much

title.en: Training error keeps falling; test error turns up
title.zh: 训练误差一路下降，测试误差会掉头向上

text.en: Fit polynomials of order 0 to 7 to 30 noisy points (noise standard deviation 0.3, so the noise variance is $\sigma^2 = 0.09$), repeat on 300 fresh training sets and average. Errors are mean squared errors.
text.zh: 对 30 个带噪声的点（噪声标准差 0.3，所以噪声方差 $\sigma^2 = 0.09$）拟合 0 到 7 阶多项式，在 300 份新训练集上重复并取平均。误差是均方误差。

alt.en: Training error falls with complexity; test error falls then rises. Bias squared falls, variance rises; the dashed floor is the noise.
alt.zh: 训练误差随复杂度下降；测试误差先降后升。偏差²下降，方差上升；虚线下限是噪声。

items.en: **Underfitting** (small $D$): high error on **both** the training and the test set. Order 0: 0.57 and 0.63.
**Overfitting** (large $D$): low training error, high test error, a **large gap**. Order 7: 0.06 against 0.27.
items.zh: **过拟合**（$D$ 大）：训练误差低，测试误差高，**差距很大**。7 阶：0.06 对 0.27。

items.en: The best test error is at order 3: 0.11, not far above the noise floor 0.09.
items.zh: 测试误差最低在 3 阶：0.11，离噪声下限 0.09 不远。

text.en: Training error alone can never reveal overfitting, because it only goes down as complexity grows. The tree analogue is error against the number of leaf nodes: training error keeps falling, test error turns up.
text.zh: 只看训练误差永远看不出过拟合，因为它随复杂度增加只会下降。决策树里对应的是：误差随叶子数的变化——训练误差一直降，测试误差掉头向上。

prompt.en: A polynomial of order 9 has a training error of 0.001 and a test error of 0.3 (noise level 0.09). A colleague says: “add more complexity, the training error is almost zero.” What is the right reading?
prompt.zh: 一个 9 阶多项式训练误差 0.001、测试误差 0.3（噪声水平 0.09）。同事说：“再加复杂度吧，训练误差快到零了。”正确的解读是？

label.en: Underfitting: more complexity is needed.

feedback.en: Underfitting shows as high error on both sets. Here the training error is tiny.
feedback.zh: 欠拟合的表现是两边误差都高。这里训练误差极小。

label.en: Overfitting: the large train–test gap says the model fits noise. Reduce complexity or add data.
label.zh: 过拟合：训练与测试之间的大差距说明模型在拟合噪声。要降复杂度或加数据。

label.en: Good fit: training error near zero is the goal.
label.zh: 拟合得好：训练误差接近零就是目标。

feedback.en: The goal is low *test* error. A training error far below the noise level means the model memorised noise.
feedback.zh: 目标是低的*测试*误差。训练误差远低于噪声水平，说明模型记住了噪声。

explain.en: Diagnose with the gap and the level, not with the training error alone.
explain.zh: 要看差距和水平来诊断，不能只看训练误差。

text.en: Before reading any curve, check how the data was collected:
text.zh: 读任何曲线之前，先看数据是怎么收集的：

items.en: **Sampling bias**: the training data is not representative of the population (patients from one city, one age group). A test set cut from the same data cannot warn you.
items.zh: **抽样偏差**（sampling bias）：训练数据不能代表总体（只有一个城市、一个年龄段的患者）。从同一份数据里切出来的测试集不会提醒你。

items.en: **Related instances**: several instances (scans, sentences) belong to one patient or one author, but we want to generalise to **new** patients. Then split by patient, or the model is tested on people it has already seen.
items.zh: **相关的实例**：好几个实例（扫描、句子）属于同一个患者或作者，而我们想泛化到**新的**患者。这时要按患者划分，否则模型是在它已经见过的人身上测试。

prompt.en: Ten scans per patient, 100 patients. You split the 1000 scans randomly 80–20 and get 98% test accuracy. On new patients the deployed model gets 80%. Most likely cause?
prompt.zh: 每位患者 10 次扫描，共 100 位患者。你把 1000 次扫描随机按 80–20 划分，测试准确率 98%。部署后在新患者上只有 80%。最可能的原因？

label.en: Underfitting.

feedback.en: Underfitting gives low accuracy on the test set too; here the test score was high.
feedback.zh: 欠拟合时测试集上准确率也低；这里测试分数很高。

label.en: Too little training data.

feedback.en: Little data hurts both estimates; “98% on test, 80% on new patients” is a leak, not a shortage.
feedback.zh: 数据少会让两边都差；“测试 98%、新患者 80%”这种模式是泄漏，不是数据不足。

label.en: Scans of the same patient were in both train and test: the model recognised patients, so the estimate was optimistic.
label.zh: 同一患者的扫描同时出现在训练和测试里：模型认出了患者，所以估计偏乐观。

explain.en: Split along the unit you want to generalise over.
explain.zh: 沿着你想泛化的那个单位去划分。

text.en: A **learning curve** plots performance against *experience*: the y-axis is accuracy, error rate or another metric; the x-axis is a condition such as the **training-set size**, the model complexity, or the number of iterations.
text.zh: **学习曲线**把表现画成*经验*的函数：纵轴是准确率、错误率或其他指标；横轴是某个条件，如**训练集大小**、模型复杂度或迭代次数。

items.en: The **training curve** is measured on the training set: how well the model has learned.
items.zh: **训练曲线**在训练集上量：模型学得多好。

items.en: The **validation curve** is measured on held-out data: how well it generalises.
items.zh: **验证曲线**在留出数据上量：它泛化得多好。

text.en: Example 1, varying the training size: split 90–10, 80–20, …, 10–90 (9 points), averaging several runs per size. It shows the **data trade-off**: more training instances usually give a better model; more evaluation instances give a more reliable estimate. One dataset cannot give both.
text.zh: 例 1，改变训练集大小：按 90–10、80–20、……、10–90 划分（9 个点），每个大小平均多次运行。它展示了**数据的取舍**：训练实例多，模型通常更好；评估实例多，估计更可靠。一份数据两者不可兼得。

text.en: Below: error against training size $N$ for a straight line ($D = 1$) fitted to the noisy sine. Training error rises (a line cannot memorise more points), test error falls, and they **meet high up**, above the noise floor.
text.zh: 下图：用直线（$D = 1$）拟合带噪声的正弦，误差随训练集大小 $N$ 的变化。训练误差上升（直线记不住更多的点），测试误差下降，两条线**在高处会合**，高于噪声下限。

alt.en: Learning curve of a straight line: training and test error converge at a high level.
alt.zh: 直线模型的学习曲线：训练和测试误差在高位会合。

text.en: At $N = 200$: training 0.283, test 0.272. The gap is tiny and the level is high. Doubling the data would not change this.
text.zh: $N = 200$ 时：训练 0.283，测试 0.272。差距很小，水平很高。数据再翻倍也不会改变。

title.en: How to read a learning curve

alt.en: Learning curve of an order-9 polynomial: a large gap that closes only slowly as data grows; the test curve starts off the chart.
alt.zh: 9 阶多项式的学习曲线：差距很大，随数据增加只缓慢缩小；测试曲线起点在图外。

text.en: Here the model is flexible. The test error starts off the chart (small $N$); at $N = 60$ the gap is 0.189, at $N = 200$ it is 0.009. More data helps, and the gap is the signal.
text.zh: 这里的模型很灵活。测试误差起点在图外（$N$ 小）；$N = 60$ 时差距是 0.189，到 $N = 200$ 时缩到 0.009。多加数据有帮助；差距就是信号。

rows.en: both errors high, curves close together
rows.zh: 两条误差都高，彼此靠近

rows.en: training error low, test error much higher: a gap
rows.zh: 训练误差低、测试误差高得多：有差距

text.en: The deck's Naive Bayes curve (training about 0.82, validation about 0.80, meeting near 0.8): the curves have met, so extra data will not move them much. If 0.8 is below what we need, the limit is the model (or the noise in the problem), so we need a richer model or better features, not more of the same data.
text.zh: 课件里朴素贝叶斯的曲线（训练约 0.82、验证约 0.80，在 0.8 附近会合）：两条线已会合，更多数据改变不大。如果 0.8 达不到要求，限制来自模型（或问题本身的噪声），要的是更丰富的模型或更好的特征，而不是更多同样的数据。

prompt.en: Training error 2%, validation error 15%, and the validation curve still slopes down at the largest training size. What do you try first?
prompt.zh: 训练误差 2%，验证误差 15%，在最大的训练集规模处验证曲线仍在下降。先试什么？

label.en: Add many more features.

feedback.en: More features raise complexity and widen the gap. That is a remedy for high bias.
feedback.zh: 更多特征提高复杂度，让差距更大。那是高偏差的对策。

label.en: Switch to a more complex model.

feedback.en: The model already fits the training data almost perfectly; more flexibility only widens the gap.
feedback.zh: 模型已经几乎完美拟合训练数据；更灵活只会让差距更大。

label.en: Collect more training data (or reduce the complexity): this is high variance.
label.zh: 收集更多训练数据（或降低复杂度）：这是高方差。

explain.en: A gap means variance; a high level with no gap means bias.
explain.zh: 有差距：方差。水平高而没有差距：偏差。

title.en: Remedies: what to change for each problem

rows.en: use a more complex model (e.g. a non-linear one); add features; boosting
rows.zh: 用更复杂的模型（如非线性的）；加特征；boosting

rows.en: the model family can now bend to the pattern
rows.zh: 模型族终于能弯到规律上

rows.en: add more training data; use fewer features (feature selection); reduce complexity; bagging
rows.zh: 加训练数据；减少特征（特征选择）；降低复杂度；bagging

rows.en: less room to chase noise; noise averages out
rows.zh: 追逐噪声的余地变小；噪声被平均掉

text.en: Complex models are prone to high variance; simple ones to high bias. Bias goes down and variance goes up as complexity grows, so the remedy for one is the cause of the other: **it is a trade-off**. Ensembles (lecture 16) escape part of it: bagging attacks variance, boosting attacks bias.
text.zh: 复杂模型容易高方差，简单模型容易高偏差。复杂度增加时偏差降、方差升，所以治一个的药正是另一个的病：**这是个权衡**。集成方法（第 16 讲）能逃开一部分：bagging 对付方差，boosting 对付偏差。

prompt.en: Which action is a remedy for high **variance**?
prompt.zh: 下面哪个是对付高**方差**的办法？

label.en: Drop some features or limit the tree depth.
label.zh: 去掉一些特征或限制树的深度。

label.en: Add polynomial features.

feedback.en: That raises complexity: it lowers bias and raises variance.
feedback.zh: 那会提高复杂度：降低偏差、提高方差。

label.en: Use boosting with deeper trees.

feedback.en: Boosting mainly reduces bias; deeper trees increase variance.
feedback.zh: boosting 主要降低偏差；更深的树增加方差。

explain.en: Match the cure to the diagnosis: gap, simplify or add data; no gap and high error, enrich.
explain.zh: 对症下药：有差距就简化或加数据；没差距而误差高就丰富模型。

rows.en: the tendency to make systematically wrong predictions
rows.zh: 倾向于做出系统性错误的预测

rows.en: the evaluation strategy over- or under-estimates performance
rows.zh: 评估方式系统性地高估或低估表现

rows.en: the training/evaluation data is not representative of the population
rows.zh: 训练/评估数据不能代表总体

rows.en: predictions change a lot when the training set changes slightly
rows.zh: 训练集稍变，预测就大变

rows.en: the estimate of performance changes a lot with the evaluation instances
rows.zh: 性能估计随评估实例大幅变化

text.en: Model bias in regression
text.zh: 回归中的模型偏差

text.en: For each evaluation instance the **signed error** is $y_i - \hat y_i$. The deck defines the bias $B$ as their average, and a model as biased if its predictions are systematically too high or too low:
text.zh: 对每个评估实例，**带符号的误差**是 $y_i - \hat y_i$。课件把偏差 $B$ 定义为它们的平均，预测系统性地偏高或偏低就是有偏：

text.en: The formal version used for the decomposition is $B = E[\hat f(x)] - f(x)$: the gap between the **average** prediction (over many training sets) and the truth. Careful: errors of $+3$ and $-3$ average to zero bias but are bad predictions. The signed average measures systematic error, not size; that is what MSE and the variance are for.
text.zh: 分解里用的形式是 $B = E[\hat f(x)] - f(x)$：（在许多训练集上取）**平均**预测与真值之间的差。注意：$+3$ 和 $-3$ 的误差平均起来偏差为零，预测却很差。带符号的平均衡量的是系统性误差，不是大小；大小要靠 MSE 和方差。

text.en: For classification the deck gives no formula (outside the scope of COMP90049): an unbiased classifier produces labels with the same distribution as the actual one; a classifier **biased towards the majority class** predicts too many instances as the majority class.
text.zh: 分类的偏差课件没有给公式（超出 COMP90049 范围）：无偏的分类器给出的标签分布与实际分布相同；**偏向多数类**的分类器把太多实例预测成多数类。

text.en: Model variance
text.zh: 模型方差

text.en: High variance: a different random training set gives very different predictions on the evaluation set. Low variance: similar predictions, **whether or not they are correct**. Zero-R has zero variance (always the majority class) and high bias.
text.zh: 方差高：换一份随机训练集，在评估集上的预测就大不相同。方差低：预测相似，**不管对不对**。Zero-R 的方差为零（永远预测多数类）而偏差很高。

title.en: Deeper: the facts about expectations the derivation needs
title.zh: 深入：推导要用的几个期望性质

text.en: The **expectation** $E[X]$ of a random variable is the average over unlimited samples. For a discrete $X$ with mass function $p$, and for a continuous one with density $p$:
text.zh: 随机变量的**期望** $E[X]$ 是无限多次抽样的平均。离散 $X$（概率质量函数 $p$）和连续 $X$（密度 $p$）分别是：

text.en: The deck's example: a Bernoulli $X \in \{0, 1\}$ with $p(0) = p(1) = \tfrac12$ has $E[X] = 0 \cdot \tfrac12 + 1 \cdot \tfrac12 = \tfrac12$. The average of $n$ samples approaches it as $n$ grows (0.8 for 10 samples, 0.44 for 100, 0.5138 for 10000 in the deck's run). “An expectation is an average with unlimited samples.”
text.zh: 课件的例子：伯努利 $X \in \{0, 1\}$，$p(0) = p(1) = \tfrac12$，则 $E[X] = 0 \cdot \tfrac12 + 1 \cdot \tfrac12 = \tfrac12$。$n$ 个样本的平均随 $n$ 增大逼近它（课件的一次运行：10 个样本 0.8，100 个 0.44，10000 个 0.5138）。“期望就是无限样本的平均。”

text.en: What the next derivation uses:
text.zh: 下一步推导用到的：

items.en: $E[c] = c$ for a constant $c$, and $E[cX] = c\,E[X]$; $E[X + Y] = E[X] + E[Y]$ (always).
items.zh: 常数 $c$：$E[c] = c$，$E[cX] = c\,E[X]$；$E[X + Y] = E[X] + E[Y]$（永远成立）。

items.en: $E[X - E[X]] = E[X] - E[X] = 0$: deviations from the mean average to zero.
items.zh: $E[X - E[X]] = E[X] - E[X] = 0$：离均值的偏差平均为零。

text.en: What is random in the decomposition: the **training set** (so $\hat f$ is random, one fit per training set) and the **noise** $\varepsilon$ of the test target. $f(x)$ at a fixed $x$ is a plain number.
text.zh: 分解里什么是随机的：**训练集**（所以 $\hat f$ 是随机的，每份训练集一个拟合）和测试目标的**噪声** $\varepsilon$。固定 $x$ 处的 $f(x)$ 只是个普通的数。

prompt.en: $X$ is the roll of a fair die. What is $E[X]$, and is it a value $X$ can take?
prompt.zh: $X$ 是一个均匀骰子的点数。$E[X]$ 是多少？它是 $X$ 能取到的值吗？

label.en: 3.5: an average, not a value you can roll.
3 or 4: the middle faces.

feedback.en: The expectation weights every face by $\tfrac16$: $(1+2+\dots+6)/6 = 3.5$. It need not be attainable.
feedback.zh: 期望给每一面权重 $\tfrac16$：$(1+2+\dots+6)/6 = 3.5$。它不必是能取到的值。

label.en: 6: the most extreme face.

feedback.en: The expectation is a probability-weighted average of all faces, not the maximum.
feedback.zh: 期望是所有面按概率加权的平均，不是最大值。

explain.en: An expectation is an average over unlimited repetitions.
explain.zh: 期望是无限次重复的平均。

title.en: Deeper: the bias-variance decomposition, line by line
title.zh: 深入：一行一行推出偏差-方差分解

say.en: Setup at one fixed input $x$. The truth is a function $f$; the observed target adds noise $\varepsilon$ (annotation or measurement error: unknown, unmeasurable). The noise has mean 0, variance $\sigma^2$, and is **independent of the training set**, hence of $\hat f$. We write $B$ for bias, $V$ for variance, $G$ for the generalisation error.
say.zh: 在某个固定的输入 $x$ 上设定。真相是函数 $f$；观测到的目标加了噪声 $\varepsilon$（标注或测量误差：未知、不可测）。噪声均值 0、方差 $\sigma^2$，并且**与训练集独立**，因此也与 $\hat f$ 独立。我们记偏差为 $B$、方差为 $V$、泛化误差为 $G$。

say.en: The expected squared prediction error, averaged over training sets (through $\hat f$) and noise. Substitute $Y = f + \varepsilon$; write $f$ for $f(x)$ and $\hat f$ for $\hat f(x)$.
say.zh: 期望平方预测误差，对训练集（通过 $\hat f$）和噪声取平均。代入 $Y = f + \varepsilon$；$f$ 记 $f(x)$，$\hat f$ 记 $\hat f(x)$。

say.en: Expand $(A + B)^2 = A^2 + 2AB + B^2$ with $A = f - \hat f$, $B = \varepsilon$, and split the expectation of the sum.
say.zh: 按 $(A + B)^2 = A^2 + 2AB + B^2$ 展开，$A = f - \hat f$，$B = \varepsilon$，并把和的期望拆开。

say.en: The cross term. $\varepsilon$ is independent of $\hat f$, so the expectation of the product is the product of the expectations; and $E[\varepsilon] = 0$. It vanishes.
say.zh: 交叉项。$\varepsilon$ 与 $\hat f$ 独立，所以乘积的期望等于期望的乘积；又 $E[\varepsilon] = 0$。它消失了。

say.en: The last term: $E[X^2] = \text{Var}(X) + E[X]^2$ with $E[\varepsilon] = 0$. This is the **irreducible error**: noise in the data that no model can predict.
say.zh: 最后一项：$E[X^2] = \text{Var}(X) + E[X]^2$，$E[\varepsilon] = 0$。这就是**不可约误差**：数据里任何模型都预测不了的噪声。

lines.tex: f - \hat f = \big(f - E[\hat f]\big) + \big(E[\hat f] - \hat f\big)

say.en: Now the first term, $E[(f - \hat f)^2]$. The trick: add and subtract the **average prediction** $E[\hat f]$. The first bracket is a fixed number (truth minus average prediction); the second is the random fluctuation of $\hat f$ around its own average.
say.zh: 现在看第一项 $E[(f - \hat f)^2]$。技巧：加减**平均预测** $E[\hat f]$。第一个括号是固定的数（真值减平均预测）；第二个是 $\hat f$ 围绕自身平均的随机波动。

lines.tex: E\big[(f - \hat f)^2\big] = \big(f - E[\hat f]\big)^2 + 2\big(f - E[\hat f]\big)E\big[E[\hat f] - \hat f\big] + E\big[(\hat f - E[\hat f])^2\big]

say.en: Expand the square again. In the middle term the fixed bracket $(f - E[\hat f])$ comes out of the expectation, and the first term is a constant, so its expectation is itself.
say.zh: 再展开一次平方。中间项里，固定的括号 $(f - E[\hat f])$ 可以提到期望外面，第一项是常数，期望就是它本身。

lines.tex: E\big[E[\hat f] - \hat f\big] = E[\hat f] - E[\hat f] = 0

say.en: The new cross term: deviations of $\hat f$ from its own average have mean zero. It vanishes too.
say.zh: 新的交叉项：$\hat f$ 偏离自身平均的偏差均值为零。它也消失了。

lines.tex: E\big[(f - \hat f)^2\big] = \underbrace{\big(f - E[\hat f]\big)^2}_{B^2} + \underbrace{E\big[(\hat f - E[\hat f])^2\big]}_{V}

say.en: What is left: the squared **bias** (how far the average prediction is from the truth) plus the **variance** (how much a single fit scatters around its average).
say.zh: 剩下的是：**偏差**的平方（平均预测离真值有多远）加上**方差**（单次拟合围绕自身平均散开多少）。

say.en: Put the two pieces together. **Expected test error = bias² + variance + irreducible noise.** The deck writes it with $\varepsilon^2$ for the last term; it means the noise variance $\sigma^2$.
say.zh: 把两部分合起来。**期望测试误差 = 偏差² + 方差 + 不可约噪声。**课件最后一项写成 $\varepsilon^2$，指的是噪声方差 $\sigma^2$。

outro.en: Reading it: bias is **inherent to the model** (even with infinite data, a straight line cannot become a sine); variance is how **over-specialised** the fit is to one training set; $\sigma^2$ is a floor set by the data, which you can never beat. Zero-R has variance 0 and large bias; a flexible model has small bias and large variance. A good model balances the two.
outro.zh: 怎么理解：偏差是**模型本身的**局限（数据无限多，直线也变不成正弦）；方差是拟合对某一份训练集**过度专门化**的程度；$\sigma^2$ 是数据设下的下限，永远超不过。Zero-R 方差为 0 而偏差大；灵活的模型偏差小而方差大。好模型在两者之间取得平衡。

prompt.en: What does the cross term $2E[\varepsilon]\,E[f - \hat f]$ equal? (Use $E[\varepsilon] = 0$.)
prompt.zh: 交叉项 $2E[\varepsilon]\,E[f - \hat f]$ 等于多少？（用 $E[\varepsilon] = 0$。）

text.en: A check by simulation. Take the noisy sine, fix $x_0 = 0.25$ (where $f = 1$), and train a straight line ($D = 1$) and an order-6 polynomial on 2000 fresh training sets of 30 points each. The average prediction, bias² and variance at $x_0$:
text.zh: 用模拟检验。取带噪声的正弦，固定 $x_0 = 0.25$（此处 $f = 1$），在 2000 份各含 30 个点的新训练集上训练一条直线（$D = 1$）和一个 6 阶多项式。在 $x_0$ 处的平均预测、偏差² 和方差：

text.en: The line is off by about 0.512 on average (the sine peaks at 1; a line cannot follow it): large bias, small variance. The order-6 fit is right on average (1.006) and at this point its variance 0.022 is hardly above the line's: here the flexible model simply wins. Variance is not the same everywhere, though: it is much larger near the two ends of the interval (the wild ends of the order-9 curve in the first figure), and averaged over all $x$ it is what makes the U-curve below turn up.
text.zh: 直线平均偏离约 0.512（正弦峰值是 1，直线跟不上）：偏差大、方差小。6 阶拟合平均下来是对的（1.006），而且在这一点上它的方差 0.022 比直线高不了多少：这里灵活的模型直接赢了。但方差并不处处一样：在区间两端要大得多（第一张图里 9 阶曲线两头的狂摆），对所有 $x$ 取平均后，正是它让下面的 U 形曲线翘起来。

text.en: A smaller version of the same trade, by hand: you estimate a mean $\mu = 2$ from $n = 4$ noisy observations (noise variance $\sigma^2 = 4$) and predict $c \cdot \bar x$, where $\bar x$ is the sample mean and $c \le 1$ shrinks it. Then $\text{Bias} = (c-1)\mu$, $\text{Var} = c^2\sigma^2/n$, so
text.zh: 同样的取舍，再手算一个小版本：从 $n = 4$ 个带噪声的观测（噪声方差 $\sigma^2 = 4$）估计均值 $\mu = 2$，预测 $c \cdot \bar x$，$\bar x$ 是样本均值，$c \le 1$ 把它往零压缩。此时 $\text{Bias} = (c-1)\mu$，$\text{Var} = c^2\sigma^2/n$，所以

text.en: $c = 1$ is unbiased but has MSE 1.00; accepting some bias with $c = 0.8$ lowers the MSE to 0.80. Setting the derivative to zero, $2(c-1)\mu^2 + 2c\sigma^2/n = 0$, gives $c^* = \mu^2/(\mu^2 + \sigma^2/n) = 0.80$. An unbiased estimator is not automatically the best one.
text.zh: $c = 1$ 无偏，但 MSE 是 1.00；接受一点偏差取 $c = 0.8$，MSE 降到 0.80。令导数为零 $2(c-1)\mu^2 + 2c\sigma^2/n = 0$，得 $c^* = \mu^2/(\mu^2 + \sigma^2/n) = 0.80$。无偏的估计量不一定是最好的。

title.en: Complexity as a knob: polynomial order, k, depth
title.zh: 复杂度是个旋钮：多项式阶数、k、深度

text.en: Look at the figure again: as complexity rises, bias² falls and variance rises. Test error is their sum plus the floor $\sigma^2$, so it is **U-shaped**; the best model sits at the bottom, not at zero training error.
text.zh: 再看那张图：复杂度升高，偏差²下降、方差上升。测试误差是它们的和再加下限 $\sigma^2$，所以是 **U 形**；最好的模型在谷底，而不是训练误差为零的地方。

alt.en: Training error falls with complexity; test error falls then rises. Bias squared falls, variance rises; the dashed floor is the noise.
alt.zh: 训练误差随复杂度下降；测试误差先降后升。偏差²下降，方差上升；虚线下限是噪声。

rows.en: $k = 1$: follows every training point, training error 0
rows.zh: $k = 1$：紧跟每个训练点，训练误差为 0

rows.en: $k = N$: predicts the global majority (or mean), the same for every input
rows.zh: $k = N$：永远预测全局多数类（或均值），对任何输入都一样

summary.en: k-NN regression: the variance is exactly σ²/k
summary.zh: k-NN 回归：方差恰好是 σ²/k

text.en: For k-NN regression the prediction at $x_0$ is the mean of $k$ neighbour targets, each with independent noise of variance $\sigma^2$. The variance of a mean of $k$ independent values is $\sigma^2/k$. With the neighbours' true values $f(x_{(l)})$ (textbook result, Hastie et al., ESL §7.3):
text.zh: k-NN 回归在 $x_0$ 处的预测是 $k$ 个近邻目标的均值，每个带方差 $\sigma^2$ 的独立噪声。$k$ 个独立值的均值的方差是 $\sigma^2/k$。设近邻的真值为 $f(x_{(l)})$（教材结果，Hastie 等，ESL §7.3）：

text.en: Larger $k$: variance $\sigma^2/k$ shrinks, but the neighbours reach further away, so the bias term grows. That is the trade-off for $k$ in one line.
text.zh: $k$ 变大：方差 $\sigma^2/k$ 缩小，但近邻伸得更远，偏差项变大。这就是 $k$ 的权衡，一行就够。

prompt.en: A decision tree has 100% training accuracy and 70% validation accuracy. Which change is most likely to improve validation accuracy?
prompt.zh: 一棵决策树训练准确率 100%、验证准确率 70%。哪个改动最可能提高验证准确率？

label.en: Limit the depth or prune the tree.
Grow the tree deeper.

feedback.en: It already fits the training data perfectly; deeper means even more variance.
feedback.zh: 它已经完美拟合了训练数据；更深意味着方差更大。

label.en: Add the test set to training.

feedback.en: That destroys the evaluation (leakage) and does not cure overfitting.
feedback.zh: 那会毁掉评估（泄漏），也治不了过拟合。

explain.en: A perfect training score with a big gap is the signature of high variance: simplify.
explain.zh: 训练满分而差距很大，是高方差的标志：简化。

text.en: The evaluation metric is itself an **estimator**. We want the true error rate of the classifier on the population, but we only have an estimate from one particular set of evaluation instances. This quality is independent of the trained model.
text.zh: 评估指标本身也是一个**估计量**。我们想知道分类器在总体上的真实错误率，手里却只有在某一组评估实例上的估计。这个质量与训练出的模型无关。

items.en: **Evaluation bias**: our estimate of effectiveness is systematically too high or too low (e.g. training error as the estimate is too low; tuning on the validation set and reporting its score is too high).
items.zh: **评估偏差**：我们对效果的估计系统性偏高或偏低（例如用训练误差当估计会偏低；在验证集上调参又报告它的分数会偏高）。

items.en: **Evaluation variance**: the estimate changes a lot as we alter the instances in the test set. It can be hard to tell apart from model variance.
items.zh: **评估方差**：换一换测试集里的实例，估计就变化很大。它很难和模型方差分开。

text.en: Two traps from the deck: we can have good accuracy on one specific evaluation set and poor accuracy on other unseen sets; and it is possible to **overfit the validation data** with respect to the evaluation function, by trying many models and keeping the one that scored best.
text.zh: 课件提醒的两个陷阱：在某个具体的评估集上准确率很好，在别的没见过的评估集上却很差；还有可能对验证数据**过拟合**：试了很多模型，只留下得分最高的那个。

rows.en: which test instances we drew (and how we split)
rows.zh: 抽到了哪些测试实例（以及怎么划分）

rows.en: change the evaluation: more test data, cross-validation, stratification
rows.zh: 改评估：更多测试数据、交叉验证、分层

chapter.zh: 评估本身的偏差与方差

title.en: Deeper: how noisy is a test accuracy?
title.zh: 深入：测试准确率有多吵？

say.en: Accuracy $A$ on $n$ independent test instances is the mean of $n$ indicator variables $X_i$: each is 1 (instance $i$ correct) with probability $p$, the model's true accuracy, and 0 otherwise.
say.zh: $n$ 个独立测试实例上的准确率 $A$，是 $n$ 个指示变量 $X_i$ 的均值：每个以概率 $p$（模型的真实准确率）取 1（正确），否则取 0。

say.en: The estimate is **unbiased** here: its expectation is the true accuracy (as long as the test set was not used to choose the model).
say.zh: 这里估计是**无偏的**：期望就是真实准确率（前提是测试集没用来选过模型）。

say.en: A 0/1 variable: $E[X^2] = p$, so $\text{Var} = p - p^2$.
say.zh: 0/1 变量：$E[X^2] = p$，所以 $\text{Var} = p - p^2$。

say.en: Independent variances add; the factor $\tfrac{1}{n}$ comes out squared.
say.zh: 独立的方差相加；系数 $\tfrac{1}{n}$ 提出来要平方。

say.en: For a true accuracy of 0.8 on a test set of $n = 100$: the standard deviation is 4 percentage points. A reported 84% and a reported 76% are compatible with the same model.
say.zh: 真实准确率 0.8、测试集 $n = 100$ 时：标准差是 4 个百分点。报告 84% 和报告 76% 可能来自同一个模型。

say.en: Four times the test data halves the noise: the noise shrinks like $1/\sqrt{n}$.
say.zh: 测试数据多四倍，噪声减半：噪声按 $1/\sqrt{n}$ 缩小。

outro.en: This is why a small test set gives a high evaluation variance, and why differences of a point or two between models on a small test set mean nothing.
outro.zh: 这就是为什么小测试集的评估方差很高，也是为什么小测试集上两个模型差一两个点说明不了什么。

title.en: Controlling bias and variance in evaluation
title.zh: 怎样控制评估里的偏差与方差

rows.en: Holdout: more training, less test data

rows.zh: 模型方差更小，评估方差**更大**

rows.en: Holdout: less training, more test data

rows.zh: 模型方差**更大**，评估方差更小

rows.en: less variance than holdout, for the model and for the evaluation
rows.zh: 模型和评估的方差都比留出法小
模型和评估的偏差都更小

rows.en: no sampling bias; lowest bias and variance in general
rows.zh: 没有抽样偏差；一般偏差和方差最低

text.en: Why the holdout row reads that way: the one split is split between two jobs. Every instance given to the test set makes the **estimate** steadier (evaluation variance down) but takes one away from training, so the **model** is weaker and more sensitive to what it was given (model variance up, and the estimate pessimistic).
text.zh: 留出法这一行为什么这样：同一份数据要分给两件事。每多给测试集一个实例，**估计**更稳（评估方差降），却从训练里拿走一个，于是**模型**更弱、对拿到什么数据更敏感（模型方差升，估计偏悲观）。

body.en: The deck says leave-one-out has the lowest bias and variance in general. Textbooks (Hastie et al., ESL §7.10) add that LOO is almost unbiased but its estimate can have **high variance**, because the $N$ training sets overlap almost entirely and the $N$ test scores are strongly correlated; $k = 5$ or 10 is often the better compromise. On the exam, give the deck's claim; mention the caveat only if asked to discuss.
body.zh: 课件说留一法一般偏差和方差最低。教材（Hastie 等，ESL §7.10）补充：留一法几乎无偏，但估计的**方差可能很高**，因为 $N$ 个训练集几乎完全重叠，$N$ 个测试分数强相关；$k = 5$ 或 10 往往是更好的折中。考试里按课件的说法答；被要求讨论时再提这个提醒。

text.en: Report the spread too
text.zh: 也报告波动

text.en: For any evaluation method, report the mean **and the variance** of the scores. With $k$ fold scores $E_i$:
text.zh: 无论哪种评估方法，都要报告分数的均值**和方差**。$k$ 个折的分数 $E_i$：

text.en: Five fold accuracies (%): 82, 78, 85, 80, 75. Mean 80; squared deviations 4, 4, 25, 0, 25; variance 11.6 (the deck divides by $k$), standard deviation 3.41. So we would write 80 ± 3.41.

prompt.en: Model A scores 81.0% and model B 82.5% on the same 100-instance test set. What can you conclude?
prompt.zh: 在同一个 100 个实例的测试集上，模型 A 得 81.0%，模型 B 得 82.5%。能得出什么结论？

label.en: B is better: 82.5 > 81.0.

feedback.en: A 1.5-point gap is well inside the roughly 4-point standard deviation of one such estimate.
feedback.zh: 1.5 个点的差距远小于这样一个估计约 4 个点的标准差。

label.en: Not much: the standard deviation of each estimate is about 4 points, so the gap is within the noise. Use more test data or cross-validation.
label.zh: 结论很有限：每个估计的标准差约 4 个点，差距在噪声之内。要用更多测试数据或交叉验证。

label.en: A is better, because it is closer to 80%.
label.zh: A 更好，因为它更接近 80%。

feedback.en: Nothing makes 80% special. Closeness to a round number is not evidence.
feedback.zh: 80% 并不特殊。接近整数不是证据。

explain.en: Compare the gap with the evaluation variance before declaring a winner.
explain.zh: 宣布赢家之前，先拿差距和评估方差比。

title.en: Model bias and MSE from predictions
title.zh: 由预测算模型偏差和 MSE

prompt.en: A regression model predicts $\hat y = (10, 16, 7, 17)$ for actual values $y = (12, 15, 9, 20)$. Using the lecture's definition (the average signed error $\frac{1}{N}\sum (y_i - \hat y_i)$), what is the model bias?
prompt.zh: 一个回归模型对实际值 $y = (12, 15, 9, 20)$ 预测 $\hat y = (10, 16, 7, 17)$。按课件的定义（带符号误差的平均 $\frac{1}{N}\sum (y_i - \hat y_i)$），模型偏差是多少？

explain.en: Signed errors $y - \hat y$: $2, -1, 2, 3$; mean $= 6/4 = 1.50$. Positive: the model predicts too low on average. (The MSE is 4.50; it also sees the sizes, which the bias ignores.)
explain.zh: 带符号误差 $y - \hat y$：$2, -1, 2, 3$；平均 $= 6/4 = 1.50$。为正：模型平均预测偏低。（MSE 是 4.50；它还看到大小，偏差则不看。）

prompt.en: For a classifier the learning curves show: training error 3% and validation error 14% at the largest training size; the validation error is still falling slowly. Which diagnosis and remedy fit?
prompt.zh: 某分类器的学习曲线显示：在最大训练集规模处训练误差 3%、验证误差 14%；验证误差仍在缓慢下降。哪种诊断与对策合适？

label.en: High bias: use a more complex model.
label.zh: 高偏差：用更复杂的模型。

feedback.en: High bias shows as high error on both curves. Here the training error is tiny; the problem is the gap.
feedback.zh: 高偏差表现为两条曲线误差都高。这里训练误差很小；问题在差距。

label.en: High variance: add training data, remove features or reduce complexity.
label.zh: 高方差：加训练数据、减特征或降复杂度。

label.en: Good trade-off: stop.

feedback.en: An 11-point gap, with the curve still falling, is not a good trade-off; more data would help.
feedback.zh: 差距 11 个点、曲线还在降，不算好；更多数据会有帮助。

label.en: High variance: add many more features.

feedback.en: Right diagnosis, wrong cure: more features raise the complexity and widen the gap.
feedback.zh: 诊断对了，药开错了：更多特征提高复杂度、加宽差距。

explain.en: Gap between the curves → variance → more data, fewer features, less complexity, bagging.
explain.zh: 两线之间有差距 → 方差 → 多数据、少特征、降复杂度、bagging。

prompt.en: A k-NN regressor averages the targets of its $k$ nearest neighbours, each with independent noise of variance $\sigma^2 = 4$. What is the variance of its prediction due to noise when $k = 8$?
prompt.zh: k-NN 回归器对 $k$ 个最近邻的目标取平均，每个带方差 $\sigma^2 = 4$ 的独立噪声。$k = 8$ 时，由噪声引起的预测方差是多少？

explain.en: The variance of the mean of $k$ independent values is $\sigma^2/k = 4/8 = 0.5$. With $k = 1$ it would be 4: the price of following every point. The bias term grows with $k$, since the neighbours are farther away.
explain.zh: $k$ 个独立值的均值的方差是 $\sigma^2/k = 4/8 = 0.5$。$k = 1$ 时是 4：紧跟每个点的代价。偏差项随 $k$ 增大，因为近邻离得更远。

prompt.en: Five-fold cross-validation gives accuracies (%) of 82, 78, 85, 80, 75. Using the lecture's formula (divide by $k$), what is the variance of the scores?
prompt.zh: 五折交叉验证得到的准确率（%）是 82、78、85、80、75。按课件的公式（除以 $k$），分数的方差是多少？

explain.en: Mean $= 80$. Squared deviations $4, 4, 25, 0, 25$ sum to 58; $58/5 = 11.6$. (Dividing by $k - 1$ would give 14.5; state which you use.)

prompt.en: A team tries 50 hyperparameter settings, picks the one with the highest score on the validation set, and reports that score as the expected performance. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: 一个团队试了 50 组超参数，选验证集上得分最高的那组，并把这个分数当作预期表现来报告。哪种说法对？

label.en: Model variance: the model is too sensitive to the training data.
label.zh: 模型方差：模型对训练数据过于敏感。

feedback.en: Model variance concerns how the fitted model changes with the training set. Here the reported *number* is the problem.
feedback.zh: 模型方差说的是拟合出的模型随训练集怎么变。这里出问题的是报告的那个*数*。

label.en: Evaluation bias: the reported score is systematically too high, because the validation set was used to pick the winner.
label.zh: 评估偏差：报告的分数系统性偏高，因为验证集被用来挑赢家。

label.en: Sampling bias: the validation set is not representative.
label.zh: 抽样偏差：验证集没有代表性。

feedback.en: Nothing says the data is unrepresentative; the selection process is the source of the optimism.
feedback.zh: 没有迹象说数据没有代表性；乐观来自选择的过程。

label.en: No problem: the validation set is meant for this.
label.zh: 没问题：验证集本来就是干这个的。

feedback.en: It is meant for *choosing*, not for the final estimate. Report performance on an untouched test set.
feedback.zh: 它是用来*选择*的，不是用来做最终估计的。要在没碰过的测试集上报告表现。

explain.en: Selecting the best of many on the same data makes its score an optimistic estimate: an evaluation bias.
explain.zh: 在同一份数据上从很多个里挑最好的，它的分数就是个乐观的估计：评估偏差。

title.en: Bias and variance in words (Section A)
title.zh: 用文字讲偏差与方差（A 部分）

prompt.en: Explain the difference between model bias and evaluation bias, and between model variance and evaluation variance. Give one example of each. (3 to 5 lines)
prompt.zh: 解释模型偏差与评估偏差的区别，以及模型方差与评估方差的区别。各举一个例子。（3 到 5 行）

key_points.en: Model bias: the model makes systematically wrong predictions (e.g. a straight line for curved data; Zero-R)
key_points.zh: 模型偏差：模型系统性地预测错（如用直线拟合曲线数据；Zero-R）

key_points.en: Evaluation bias: the evaluation method systematically over- or under-estimates performance (e.g. testing on training data, tuning on the test set)
key_points.zh: 评估偏差：评估方法系统性地高估或低估表现（如在训练数据上测试、在测试集上调参）

key_points.en: Model variance: predictions change a lot when the training set changes (e.g. a deep tree, 1-NN)
key_points.zh: 模型方差：训练集一变，预测大变（如深树、1-NN）

key_points.en: Evaluation variance: the performance estimate changes a lot with the test instances (e.g. a small holdout set)
key_points.zh: 评估方差：性能估计随测试实例大幅变化（如很小的留出集）

key_points.en: Model bias and variance are about the learned model; evaluation bias and variance are about the number we report
key_points.zh: 模型的偏差与方差关乎学到的模型；评估的偏差与方差关乎我们报告的数

model_answer.en: Model bias is the tendency of the model to make systematically wrong predictions, for example a linear model fitted to curved data, or Zero-R. Evaluation bias is when the evaluation strategy systematically over- or under-estimates the performance, for example measuring accuracy on the training data or tuning on the test set. Model variance is the sensitivity of the model to the particular training set: a deep decision tree or 1-NN changes a lot when a few training instances change. Evaluation variance is the variability of the performance estimate with the choice of test instances, for example with a small holdout set. So model bias and variance describe the learned model, while evaluation bias and variance describe how trustworthy the number is that we report.
model_answer.zh: Model bias is the tendency of the model to make systematically wrong predictions, for example a linear model fitted to curved data, or Zero-R. Evaluation bias is when the evaluation strategy systematically over- or under-estimates the performance, for example measuring accuracy on the training data or tuning on the test set. Model variance is the sensitivity of the model to the particular training set: a deep decision tree or 1-NN changes a lot when a few training instances change. Evaluation variance is the variability of the performance estimate with the choice of test instances, for example with a small holdout set. So model bias and variance describe the learned model, while evaluation bias and variance describe how trustworthy the number is that we report.

explain.en: Four terms, each with a definition and an example, and the one-line contrast.
explain.zh: 四个术语，各有定义和例子，再加一句对比。

title.zh: 诊断并改进（C 部分风格）

prompt.en: You train a decision tree on 2000 labelled emails for spam detection. It has 100% training accuracy and 82% accuracy on a validation set. Describe what the learning curve of training size against error would look like, diagnose the problem, and propose three changes with reasons. (A third of a page)
prompt.zh: 你在 2000 封有标签的邮件上训练决策树做垃圾邮件检测。训练准确率 100%，验证集准确率 82%。描述训练集大小对误差的学习曲线会是什么样，诊断问题，并提出三项改动和理由。（约三分之一页）

key_points.en: Curve: training error near 0, validation error much higher: a large gap that narrows slowly with N
key_points.zh: 曲线：训练误差接近 0，验证误差高得多：差距很大，随 N 增大缓慢缩小

key_points.en: Diagnosis: high variance / overfitting (the tree memorises noise)
key_points.zh: 诊断：高方差/过拟合（树记住了噪声）

key_points.en: Remedy 1: limit depth or prune (reduce complexity)
key_points.zh: 对策 1：限制深度或剪枝（降复杂度）

key_points.en: Remedy 2: more training data, or fewer features (feature selection)
key_points.zh: 对策 2：更多训练数据，或更少特征（特征选择）

key_points.en: Remedy 3: bagging (a random forest) to average out variance; choose the depth on validation data or by cross-validation, not on the test set
key_points.zh: 对策 3：bagging（随机森林）平均掉方差；深度要在验证数据上或用交叉验证选，不能用测试集

model_answer.en: The learning curve would show a training error near 0 and a validation error around 18%, with a large gap that closes only slowly as the training size grows. This is high variance, i.e. overfitting: the fully grown tree memorises the noise of these 2000 emails. I would (1) limit the tree depth or prune it, which reduces the model complexity and so the variance, with the depth chosen on a validation set or by cross-validation; (2) collect more labelled emails or remove uninformative features, since more data and fewer features both reduce variance; and (3) use bagging, such as a random forest, which averages many trees trained on bootstrap samples and so cancels much of the variance. I would not add features or make the tree deeper, as that increases the variance.
model_answer.zh: The learning curve would show a training error near 0 and a validation error around 18%, with a large gap that closes only slowly as the training size grows. This is high variance, i.e. overfitting: the fully grown tree memorises the noise of these 2000 emails. I would (1) limit the tree depth or prune it, which reduces the model complexity and so the variance, with the depth chosen on a validation set or by cross-validation; (2) collect more labelled emails or remove uninformative features, since more data and fewer features both reduce variance; and (3) use bagging, such as a random forest, which averages many trees trained on bootstrap samples and so cancels much of the variance. I would not add features or make the tree deeper, as that increases the variance.

explain.en: State the picture, name the diagnosis, then give remedies that match it, each with its reason.
explain.zh: 先说图的样子，点明诊断，再给与之匹配的对策，每条带理由。

rows.en: underfit: both errors high; overfit: low training error, large gap. Complexity = parameters, polynomial order, tree depth/leaves
rows.zh: 欠拟合：两边误差都高；过拟合：训练误差低、差距大。复杂度 = 参数数、多项式阶数、树深度/叶子数

rows.en: performance against training size (or complexity, iterations); training vs validation curve; the gap shows variance, the level shows bias
rows.zh: 表现随训练集大小（或复杂度、迭代）的变化；训练曲线对验证曲线；差距看方差，水平看偏差

rows.en: more data does not help by itself; fix: more complex model, more features, boosting
rows.zh: 多加数据本身没用；对策：更复杂的模型、更多特征、boosting

rows.en: more data helps; fix: more data, fewer features, less complexity, bagging
rows.zh: 多加数据有用；对策：更多数据、更少特征、降复杂度、bagging

rows.en: $B = E[\hat f] - f$ (regression: mean of $y - \hat y$); $V = E[(\hat f - E\hat f)^2]$
rows.zh: $B = E[\hat f] - f$（回归：$y - \hat y$ 的平均）；$V = E[(\hat f - E\hat f)^2]$

rows.en: $G = B^2 + V + \sigma^2$; cross terms vanish because $E[\varepsilon] = 0$ and $E[\hat f - E\hat f] = 0$
rows.zh: $G = B^2 + V + \sigma^2$；交叉项消失是因为 $E[\varepsilon] = 0$、$E[\hat f - E\hat f] = 0$

rows.en: k-NN: small k = low bias, high variance; trees: deeper = more variance; polynomial: higher order = more variance
rows.zh: k-NN：k 小 = 低偏差高方差；树：越深方差越大；多项式：阶数越高方差越大

rows.en: bias: the strategy over/under-estimates; variance: the estimate moves with the test instances ($\text{SD} = \sqrt{p(1-p)/n}$)
rows.zh: 偏差：评估方式高估/低估；方差：估计随测试实例变化（$\text{SD} = \sqrt{p(1-p)/n}$）

rows.en: holdout: more training = less model variance, more evaluation variance; k-fold: less variance; stratification: less bias; LOO: no sampling bias; report mean and variance of the folds
rows.zh: 留出法：训练多 = 模型方差小、评估方差大；k 折：方差更小；分层：偏差更小；留一：无抽样偏差；报告各折的均值和方差

body.en: Say which bias or variance you mean (model or evaluation). Read the gap and the level of a learning curve before naming a remedy.
body.zh: 说清你指的是哪种偏差或方差（模型还是评估）。先读学习曲线的差距和水平，再说对策。
